relations.title: Escuela de criterio y comunidades de práctica
Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: The invisible-talent account could motivate a blinded recognition study while retaining a different unit of analysis from the Attribution Gap protocol.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: Work-based talent recognition illustrates why visible credentials and demonstrated capability should be assessed separately, while retaining a different unit of analysis from application-level attribution.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Genuine contribution should be classified at the task episode, not inferred from a person's title, credentials or membership in an elite team.

relations.title: Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering
relations.reading: The talent-formation model suggests how coherence-carrying capacity could be cultivated and observed through work rather than inferred from credentials or headcount.

relations.title: El cliclo de la frontera: de Exploradores a Explotadores
relations.reading: The invisible-talent model offers a useful counterpoint to symbolic celebration: capability remains alive through formation, operational missions and opportunities to exercise judgment.
